instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Apex is a junior mining exploration company focused on lithium and rare earth mineral prospecting in northern Portugal. Currently in the geological survey and drilling phase with 15 active concessions. Seeking to modernize core sample analysis with spectrometry and AI-based mineral identification. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: Apex relies heavily on traditional geological knowledge combined with nascent data science to optimize exploration targets. The current operational bottleneck involves integrating disparate legacy systems (geological modeling, ERP, and field operations) into a cohesive digital platform.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

opportunities.title: Field Data Automation using IoT Sensors
opportunities.rationale: Deploying low-cost environmental sensors on drill sites could provide real-time data streams for geological modeling and compliance tracking, which is critical for long-term risk management.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-risk drilling sites in Q3 for pilot sensor deployment.
Develop a phased integration plan between new sensors and existing database infrastructure.
resources_needed: Dedicated IT engineer time reallocation (1 FTE)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual data entry errors by 25% across pilot sites.
milestones: Pilot deployment and data validation complete within 3 months.
Full operational rollout plan finalized for next fiscal year.

opportunities.title: Proprietary AI-Driven Mineral Discovery Engine
opportunities.rationale: Develop a proprietary machine learning model that analyzes hyperspectral core samples and geological survey data faster than competitors, allowing for highly targeted exploration in weeks rather than months.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated 'Innovation Lab' team focused solely on ML model development.
Secure partnership or acquisition of a specialized remote sensing AI startup.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in successful mineral discovery hits by 30% YoY.
milestones: Proof-of-concept model trained on existing sample data within 9 months.
Beta testing with internal geological teams and external partners.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Customer Experience (CX) Portal for Investors
opportunities.rationale: Modernize the investor and partner interface with a unified digital portal, providing real-time updates on ESG compliance, operational safety metrics, and concession status to strengthen switching costs.

first_actions: Audit current data points required for the portal.
Design UX/UI prototypes focused on mobile accessibility.
resources_needed: IT development hours allocated from existing budget
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in investor portal unique visits by 50%.
milestones: Full digital portal launch for key stakeholders within 12 months.

next_steps.action: Initiate a feasibility study and resource allocation for the AI-Driven Mineral Discovery Engine.
Implement phase one of the Field Data Automation project to demonstrate immediate operational efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Siloed Innovation Pipeline: Lack of a unified process connecting basic research (geology) to commercial application (exploration tech).
Talent and Velocity Bottleneck: Current internal structure struggles to move fast, hindered by slow compliance and traditional organizational culture.
Legacy Systems Integration Burden: Significant time spent integrating disparate geological modeling and operational systems.
Limited Digital Marketing Reach: Underutilization of modern digital tools to defend market share against high-pressure competitors.
